pairs.why: Both are near-identical brushed-grey hats, but B's band has a tied keeper loop, so it reads more like a real, built hat, the way the real jacket and bugle cards show how they are made.
Same pair as q032 with the sides swapped: A's band has the tied keeper loop, so it looks like a real hat, while B's plain band looks more like a molded shape.
They are almost the same; B's crown has slightly softer, less streaky shading, which is a little closer to the smooth but not ultra-smooth finish on the real cards.
There is very little to separate them; A's surface reads a touch smoother and softer, with less of the brushed-metal streaking the texture lessons marked down.
B adds a tied keeper on the band, so the hat looks put together like a real object; the finish on both is otherwise about the same.
A has the tied keeper loop on the band and a slightly fuller brim, so it is built more like a real hat than B's plain wrap-around band.
They are nearly identical; B's crown is a bit lighter and smoother, with fainter brushed streaks, which is closer to the soft real-card finish.
This is close to a toss-up; A's shading is slightly softer and less metallic-streaked, so it sits a little nearer the smooth painted finish of the real cards.
